title: Align Implementation Knowledge with deterministic query design
rawUserRequest: 查收《AI Cockpit 轻量化实现知识查询设计》，开始对应。保持 AI Cockpit 为可信工程事实层，仅实现 Implementation Knowledge Record 与 Knowledge Query Interface，并补齐对象安装工程继承和可验证的边界。

declaredIntent.summary: 把当前已有的 Implementation Knowledge Projection / Query 实现与最新轻量化设计逐项对齐：事实仍来自 Contract、Summary、Outcome 和 Evidence，Record 仍是可重建 Projection，Query 仍是确定性 read-only 接口；补齐显式日期、supersession latestKnownRecord、命令兼容别名、结果契约和安装 parity。

outOfScope: Vector DB, embeddings, RAG, LLM query engine, prompt routing, or semantic similarity
Chat UI, customer-support bot, Agent Runtime, Workflow Engine, or external Wiki/Backlog indexing
Automatic current-code semantic validation or inferred Design Reason
Automatic historical backfill for missing Implementation Approach
Changing the Outcome/Human Report customer-facing generation boundary
Publishing a release or changing immutable release tags

sources.reason: Current repository authority for the evidence-bound projection and query surface.
Existing projection generator and deterministic index builder whose fact-preserving behavior this Work Item extends.
Existing lifecycle point that generates the projection from final archive paths.
Adopter-facing capability ownership and installed-surface truth.
Exact current merged base after the preceding query implementation Work Item.

riskAssessment.reason: The correction changes a trusted machine-readable interface and installed capability contract; it must remain deterministic, evidence-bound, read-only, and fail closed.

reasons: The Work Item changes governance scripts, schemas, installer delivery, and an adopter-facing interface.
Strict quality is required to prove source and installed parity without weakening trust boundaries.

executionDecision.reason: The design is concrete, the current implementation exposes auditable deltas, and the requested corrections are local and testable without introducing an Agent-layer feature.

preReviewWarnings: Preserve backward-compatible record fields where possible; do not weaken existing stale-evidence checks.
Do not make query output depend on timestamps or semantic inference.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record before-edit and before-finish checkpoints because the interface and installer surface are governed artifacts.

acceptance: Implementation Knowledge Record remains a rebuildable Projection sourced only from Contract, Summary, Outcome, Evidence, and Git identity; no Agent memory or inferred historical reason is added.
Verified claims require existing repository-relative evidence with current digest; missing/conflicting evidence produces partial/unknown and never verified.
Legacy Work Items remain queryable as partial with missing Implementation Approach represented as unknown; no automatic backfill is performed.

Record preserves Implementation Approach, Design Decisions, Changes, Effects, Evidence, generatedFrom source digests, mergedCommit, explicit date when supplied, and effective/current validity without breaking existing records.
Explicit supersedes relationships are validated and deterministic query output identifies the latest known record only when the relationship is explicit; no similarity inference is performed.
Query supports exact conjunctive work-item, topic, component, commit, exact/range date, and optional status filters; it is machine-readable, stable, read-only, and fail-closed.

Query offers the design command/result compatibility surface while retaining the declared structured output contract; no natural-language, semantic, embedding, RAG, or current-code validation capability is added.
Fresh adopter installation receives the projection/query scripts, schemas, Make targets, and documentation surface; parity tests execute the installed entrypoints and query path.
Knowledge index is deterministic, lightweight, rebuildable, and rejects stale/missing record or source bindings.
Direct Outcome remains independently visible in the conversation with exactly one traffic-light status line; this Work Item cannot finish without a complete green Outcome.
guidelines: Evidence over Self-Declaration: never upgrade unknown or incomplete historical knowledge from inference.
Keep AI Cockpit Core as a Repository Governance Layer; natural-language understanding and answer composition remain external Agent responsibilities.
Use deterministic exact filters and stable ordering; do not introduce semantic ranking or confidence scores.
Treat Contract, Summary, Outcome, and Evidence as authoritative; Knowledge Record and Index are projections that may be rebuilt.
Adopter-facing capability claims require Installer Catalog, installed artifact, and Fresh Adopter parity evidence.

intent.problem: The current projection/query implementation covers the core feature but does not fully match the newly received lightweight design contract for command compatibility, explicit dates, supersession resolution, and state projection.
constraints: Implement exactly two Core capabilities: Implementation Knowledge Record and Knowledge Query Interface.
Preserve fail-closed evidence behavior and the existing archive integration.
Do not create a search engine or Agent answer-generation layer.
Keep the capability installable and verifiable in a fresh adopter repository.
intent.rationale: A small, deterministic, evidence-bound interface gives external Agents trusted facts without expanding AI Cockpit into an LLM or semantic search platform.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: New code Work Item with verified Implementation Approach and Design Decision
scenarioCoverage.expected: Record projects verified implementation, decision, effects, evidence paths/digests, and source digests.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run projection unit tests and validate the generated record against its schema and checker.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Legacy Work Item without Implementation Approach
scenarioCoverage.expected: Record remains partial and implementation/design reason is unknown; no guessed text appears.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run legacy projection regression and inspect the machine-readable record.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Query exposes the explicit relationship and latestKnownRecord=WI-B; absent relationship does not infer recency.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run supersession graph tests including conflicting and missing references.

scenarioCoverage.expected: All filters combine with AND, dates use explicit record fields, result order is stable, and query writes nothing.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run CLI/Make contract tests, repeated read-only queries, date boundary tests, and schema validation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Missing/stale evidence, identity mismatch, or invalid index
scenarioCoverage.expected: Query/generator fails closed or returns partial/unknown; verified is never emitted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run stale digest, missing path, identity mismatch, and invalid index regressions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Installed projection and query entrypoints, schemas, aliases, and Make targets work without copying template knowledge history.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run fresh adopter parity test and installed help/query dry-run checks.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly instructed the agent to receive the design and begin corresponding implementation; the scope excludes destructive operations and external publication.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff while preserving archived historical records; rebuild the Knowledge Record/Index from authoritative archive sources if a projection change must be rolled back.
